text: I'm more into in-store shopping, to be honest.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: In a store you can see things and touch them — I think touching is the most important part.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: There's a whole different experience: not just seeing, but touching, trying things on.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: But online shopping has its advantages too — it's so accessible.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: So mostly I do online shopping, but in my heart I prefer stores.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: Actually, if the technology ever developed to the point where I could just click my phone and be shopping in a real store — then I would definitely choose in-store shopping.
